```{r setup}
#! include: false

library(breakaway)
library(treemapify)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

output_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation_qmd", "20261007")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE)

set.seed(42)

# Colour Brewer paired palette
colour_brewer <- setNames(append(as.list(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(12, "Paired")), c("#737373", "#FFFFFF", "#000000")), c("blue", "darkblue", "green", "darkgreen", "red", "darkred", "orange", "darkorange", "purple", "darkpurple", "yellow", "brown", "grey", "white", "black"))

# Paul Tol's vibrant palette - colourblind friendly
vibrant_colours <- c("#CC3311", "#0077BB", "#009988", "#EE3377", "#EE7733", "#33BBEE")
# Paul Tol's muted palette - plus 3 extras
muted_colours <- c("#882255", "#332288", "#DDCC77", "#117733", "#88CCEE", "#CC6677", "#44AA99", "#999933", "#AA4499", "#BBBBBB", "#EE7733", "#CC3311")
# Paul Tol's bright palette - colourblind friendly
bright_colours <- c("#4477AA", "#EE6677", "#228833", "#CCBB44", "#66CCEE", "#AA3377", "#BBBBBB")

cluster_type_levels <- c("genome_linked", "multi_sample", "multi_hit", "single_singleton")

# Short marker names for plots, ordered by marker number
# e.g. S3.1.ribosomal_protein_L2_rplB -> RP_L2_rplB
marker_label <- function(marker) {
  marker_n <- as.integer(str_extract(marker, "(?<=^S3\\.)\\d+"))
  marker %>%
    str_remove("^S3\\.\\d+\\.") %>%
    str_replace("ribosomal_protein", "RP") %>%
    str_replace("ribosomal", "R") %>%
    fct_reorder(marker_n)
}
```

```{r wrangling}
input_dir <- here("results", "species_estimation", "20260704")
wrangling_path <- here(output_dir, "wrangling.RData")
processed_summary_path <- here(input_dir, "species_count_complete.tsv")
metadata_path <- here("results", "sample_metadata", "sandpiper_39_sample_metadata_with_organism.tsv")
wrangling_objects <- c("summary", "cluster_summary", "cumulative_year",
                       "prevalence_histogram", "cohort_samples")

# Rebuild the cache whenever process_species_estimation.py rewrites its output
if (file.exists(wrangling_path) &&
    file.mtime(wrangling_path) > file.mtime(processed_summary_path)) {
  # Restore only the data, not settings such as output_dir
  wrangling_cache <- new.env()
  load(wrangling_path, envir = wrangling_cache)
  list2env(mget(wrangling_objects, envir = wrangling_cache), envir = environment())
  rm(wrangling_cache)
  print("Using prior wrangling")
} else {
  summary <- read_tsv(here(input_dir, "summary.tsv"))

  cluster_summary <- tibble(
      marker = list.dirs(here(input_dir), full.names = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
    ) %>%
    filter(str_detect(marker, "^S3.")) %>%
    mutate(
      tsv_path = here(input_dir, marker, str_c(marker, ".tsv")),
      data = map(tsv_path, function(path) {
        marker_name <- basename(dirname(path))
        read_tsv(path) %>%
        left_join(
          read_tsv(here(input_dir, marker_name, "globdb_matches.tsv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   col_select = c(id, globdb_status)),
          by = "id"
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          # rep_status = factor(unknown, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # rep_hits = hits,
          # cluster_n = cluster_size,
          cluster_samples = n_samples,
          cluster_status = globdb_status == "confirmed",
          cluster_status = factor(cluster_status, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE), labels = c("GlobDB", "unknown")),
          # cluster_max_hits = max_hits,
          cluster_total_hits = total_hits,
          cluster_type = case_when(
            cluster_status == "GlobDB" ~ "genome_linked",
            cluster_samples > 1 ~ "multi_sample",
            cluster_total_hits > 1 ~ "multi_hit",
            TRUE ~ "single_singleton"
          ),
        ) %>%
        group_by(cluster_type) %>%
        summarise(
          n = n(),
          size_min = min(cluster_samples),
          size_max = max(cluster_samples),
          size_median = median(cluster_samples),
          total_hits_min = min(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_max = max(cluster_total_hits),
          total_hits_median = median(cluster_total_hits),
          .groups = "drop"
          )
      }),
    ) %>%
    select(-c(tsv_path)) %>%
    unnest(data)

  species_counts <- read_tsv(processed_summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cumulative_year <- species_counts %>%
    filter(stratum %in% c("year", "human_per_year")) %>%
    group_by(marker, stratum, stratum_value) %>%
    summarise(species = sum(species_count), .groups = "drop") %>%
    transmute(marker,
              cohort = if_else(stratum == "year", "all", "human-gut"),
              year = as.integer(stratum_value), species)

  # Sample-count histograms (f_k = species seen in exactly k samples)
  prevalence_histogram <- species_counts %>%
    filter(stratum %in% c("all", "human_all"), stratum_value == "all") %>%
    transmute(marker,
              cohort = if_else(stratum == "all", "all", "human-gut"),
              sample_count, species_count)

  cohort_samples <- read_tsv(metadata_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(all = n(), `human-gut` = sum(organism == "human gut metagenome", na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "cohort", values_to = "n_samples")

  rm(species_counts)
  save(list = wrangling_objects, file = wrangling_path)
}
```

```{r stats}
# Min/max/median OTU and cluster counts
summary %>%
  summarise(
    min_otus = min(num_otus),
    max_otus = max(num_otus),
    median_otus = median(num_otus),
    min_clusters = min(num_clusters),
    max_clusters = max(num_clusters),
    median_clusters = median(num_clusters)
  )

# Cluster types
cluster_summary %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster_type,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  )

# Cluster type proportions
cluster_summary %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = cluster_type,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    total = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric))),
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ .x / total)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(genome_linked, multi_sample, multi_hit, single_singleton),
    names_to = "cluster_type",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(cluster_type) %>%
  summarise(
    min_prop = min(prop),
    max_prop = max(prop),
    median_prop = median(prop),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r analysis}
# Stacked barplot of cluster types per marker
cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(marker, cluster_type, n, prop) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(n, prop), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    marker = marker_label(marker),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = marker, y = value, fill = cluster_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlab("Marker") +
  ylab("Count / Proportion") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_barplot.png"), width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 600)

# Treemap of cluster types as a median proportion across markers
cluster_type_treemap <- cluster_summary %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    cluster_type = factor(cluster_type, levels = cluster_type_levels)
    ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(cluster_type) %>%
  summarise(median_prop = median(prop), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(area = median_prop, fill = cluster_type, label = cluster_type)) +
  treemapify::geom_treemap() +
  treemapify::geom_treemap_text(
    colour = "white", place = "centre",
    grow = FALSE, reflow = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = muted_colours, drop = FALSE) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cluster_type_treemap.png"), cluster_type_treemap,
       width = 12, height = 12, dpi = 600)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Sample rarefaction and cumulative-year figures
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Species accumulation as a function of the fraction of samples included.
# Expected species in a random subset of n of N samples, computed exactly from
# the sample-count histogram (incidence-based rarefaction, Colwell et al. 2012):
#   S(n) = sum_k f_k * (1 - choose(N - k, n) / choose(N, n))
# N is every sample in the cohort, including samples without hits for a marker.
rarefaction_data <- prevalence_histogram %>%
  inner_join(cohort_samples, by = "cohort") %>%
  cross_join(tibble(fraction = seq(.1, 1, .1))) %>%
  mutate(n = ceiling(n_samples * fraction),
         detected = 1 - exp(lchoose(n_samples - sample_count, n) - lchoose(n_samples, n))) %>%
  group_by(marker, cohort, fraction) %>%
  summarise(species = sum(species_count * detected), .groups = "drop")

# One row per cohort: y-axis shared across markers, free between cohorts
marker_facet_theme <- theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = .5, hjust = 1)
)

rarefaction_plot <- rarefaction_data %>%
  mutate(marker = marker_label(marker)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fraction, species, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) +
  facet_grid(cohort ~ marker, scales = "free_y") +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(.2, 1, .2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of samples", y = "Expected species observed") +
  theme_cowplot() + marker_facet_theme
ggsave(here(output_dir, "sample_rarefaction.png"), rarefaction_plot,
       width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300)

cumulative_year_plot <- cumulative_year %>%
  mutate(marker = marker_label(marker)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, species, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) + geom_point(size = .6) +
  facet_grid(cohort ~ marker, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2020, 10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Collection year (cumulative through year)", y = "Species observed") +
  theme_cowplot() + marker_facet_theme
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cumulative_year_species.png"), cumulative_year_plot,
       width = 20, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# Species against cumulative samples, adding samples in collection-year order.
# Unlike the year axis, this is not flattened by the few recent samples.
# Samples without a collection year are excluded, as in cumulative_year.
dated_samples <- read_tsv(metadata_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(year = suppressWarnings(as.integer(year)),
            human = organism %in% "human gut metagenome") %>%
  filter(!is.na(year))
cumulative_samples <- bind_rows(
    dated_samples %>% count(year, name = "samples") %>% mutate(cohort = "all"),
    dated_samples %>% filter(human) %>% count(year, name = "samples") %>% mutate(cohort = "human-gut")
  ) %>%
  right_join(distinct(cumulative_year, cohort, year), by = c("cohort", "year")) %>%
  replace_na(list(samples = 0)) %>%
  arrange(cohort, year) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  mutate(cumulative_samples = cumsum(samples)) %>%
  ungroup()
cumulative_sample_data <- cumulative_year %>%
  inner_join(cumulative_samples, by = c("cohort", "year"))

# Cohorts have very different sample totals, so each gets its own row with
# x and y axes shared across markers
cumulative_samples_plot <- map(c("all", "human-gut"), function(cohort_name) {
  cumulative_sample_data %>%
    filter(cohort == cohort_name) %>%
    mutate(marker = marker_label(marker)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(cumulative_samples, species)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = .7, colour = vibrant_colours[if (cohort_name == "all") 1 else 2]) +
    geom_point(size = .6, colour = vibrant_colours[if (cohort_name == "all") 1 else 2]) +
    facet_wrap(~ marker, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
    labs(title = cohort_name, x = "Cumulative samples (in collection-year order)",
         y = "Species observed") +
    theme_cowplot() + marker_facet_theme
}) %>%
  plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 1)
ggsave(here(output_dir, "cumulative_samples_species.png"), cumulative_samples_plot,
       width = 20, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r richness}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Richness estimates for all samples and human-gut samples
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
richness_input <- read_tsv(processed_summary_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
richness_markers <- sort(unique(richness_input$marker))

get_frequency_table <- function(marker_name, cohort_name) {
  stratum_name <- if (cohort_name == "all") "all" else "human_all"
  richness_input %>%
    filter(marker == marker_name, stratum == stratum_name,
           stratum_value == "all") %>%
    select(sample_count, species_count) %>%
    rename(frequency = sample_count, count = species_count) %>%
    arrange(frequency)
}

run_richness_method <- function(marker_name, cohort_name, method) {
  frequencies <- get_frequency_table(marker_name, cohort_name)
  if (!nrow(frequencies)) return(tibble())
  estimate <- method(frequencies)
  tibble(
    marker = marker_name,
    cohort = cohort_name,
    estimate = unname(estimate$estimate),
    error = if (!is.null(estimate$error)) unname(estimate$error) else NA_real_,
    model = if (!is.null(estimate$model)) as.character(estimate$model) else NA_character_
  )
}

richness_results <- map_dfr(c("all", "human-gut"), function(cohort_name) {
  map_dfr(richness_markers, function(marker_name) {
    frequencies <- get_frequency_table(marker_name, cohort_name)
    if (!nrow(frequencies)) return(tibble())
    breakaway_result <- breakaway(frequencies)
    sample_result <- sample_richness(frequencies)
    nof1_result <- breakaway_nof1(frequencies)
    f1 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 1]
    f2 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 2]
    f3 <- frequencies$count[frequencies$frequency == 3]
    tibble(
      marker = marker_name,
      cohort = cohort_name,
      breakaway_estimate = unname(breakaway_result$estimate),
      breakaway_error = unname(breakaway_result$error),
      breakaway_model = as.character(breakaway_result$model),
      observed_estimate = unname(sample_result$estimate),
      nof1_estimate = unname(nof1_result$estimate),
      nof1_error = unname(nof1_result$error),
      nof1_model = as.character(nof1_result$model),
      f1_f2_ratio = if (length(f1) && length(f2) && f2 != 0) f1 / f2 else NA_real_,
      f2_f3_ratio = if (length(f2) && length(f3) && f3 != 0) f2 / f3 else NA_real_
    )
  })
})

write_tsv(richness_results, here(output_dir, "richness_estimates.tsv"))

richness_plot_data <- richness_results %>%
  select(marker, cohort, breakaway_estimate, breakaway_error, breakaway_model,
         observed_estimate, nof1_estimate, nof1_error, nof1_model) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(marker, cohort),
    names_to = c("method", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(estimate|error|model)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = recode(
    method,
    breakaway = "Estimated total",
    observed = "Observed",
    nof1 = "Estimated total (singletons excluded)"
  ),
  marker = marker_label(marker))

plot_richness <- function(plot_data) {
  plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = marker, y = estimate, colour = method)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = .6), size = 1.8) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = pmax(0, estimate - error), ymax = estimate + error),
    position = position_dodge(width = .6), width = .2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())) +
  labs(x = "Marker", y = "Richness estimate", colour = "Method") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
}
ggsave(here(output_dir, "richness_estimates.png"), plot_richness(richness_plot_data),
       width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)

# Without fits that fell back to a Kemp model (unstable, very large errors)
richness_no_kemp <- richness_plot_data %>% filter(is.na(model) | model != "Kemp")
ggsave(here(output_dir, "richness_estimates_no_kemp.png"), plot_richness(richness_no_kemp),
       width = 15, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

```{r summary_figure}
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#--- Summary figure: each panel summarises across all markers
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Lines/points are the median across markers; ribbons/bars span min to max.
cohort_colours <- c(all = vibrant_colours[1], `human-gut` = vibrant_colours[2])
short_number <- scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale())

summarise_markers <- function(x, ...) {
  x %>%
    group_by(...) %>%
    summarise(median = median(species), min = min(species), max = max(species),
              .groups = "drop")
}

summary_richness <- richness_no_kemp %>%
  group_by(cohort, method) %>%
  summarise(median = median(estimate), min = min(estimate), max = max(estimate),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(method, median, colour = cohort)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max)) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cohort_colours) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = scales::label_wrap(15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = short_number) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Richness estimate") +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "none")

summary_cumulative_year <- cumulative_year %>%
  summarise_markers(cohort, year) %>%
  ggplot(aes(year, median, colour = cohort, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max), alpha = .25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cohort_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = short_number) +
  labs(x = "Collection year (cumulative through year)", y = "Species observed") +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "none")

summary_rarefaction <- rarefaction_data %>%
  summarise_markers(cohort, fraction) %>%
  ggplot(aes(fraction, median, colour = cohort, fill = cohort)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max), alpha = .25, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = .7) +
  facet_wrap(~ cohort, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cohort_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cohort_colours) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, breaks = seq(.2, 1, .2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = short_number) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  labs(x = "Fraction of samples", y = "Expected species observed") +
  theme_cowplot() + theme(legend.position = "none")

summary_figure <- plot_grid(
  cluster_type_treemap, summary_richness,
  summary_cumulative_year, summary_rarefaction,
  labels = "auto", ncol = 2
)
ggsave(here(output_dir, "summary_figure.png"), summary_figure,
       width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
